summary: Market Technology Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO on July 27, 2026. It sold 20,500,000 units at $10.00 each, including the over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $205 million. Each unit consists of one Class A share and one-half warrant (strike $11.50). Simultaneously, the sponsor and BTIG purchased 712,500 private placement units at $10.00 each for $7.125 million. A total of $206.025 million was deposited into a trust account, equating to $10.05 per public share. The company is a SPAC, and the trust collateral supports future redemptions; what to watch is the search for a target and potential de-SPAC, with risk-arb centered on trust value versus trading price.
